description: mods (function hooks, under CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1): the backtick guard (a Bash call that would hand sminos a backtick the shell runs is refused, with the stdin form to use), the bridge (the session's live stream and its control from another terminal on the machine and from the desk — sminos watch, steer, interrupt, model, compact, decide, answer — through a child, sminos bridge, serving its endpoint; its <message> marks and async asks reach the project's log as they are written), mcp__sminos__AskUserQuestion (the built-in's input plus async, which withdraws the built-in; or, by a choice each process makes once at its start, the question sheet: questions put on the session's sheet under $SMINOS_HOME/sheet, revised and withdrawn, answered from a surface or sminos sheet and delivered in envelopes, a terminal line above the prompt; SMINOS_QUESTION_SHEET, off by default, opts a terminal session in, and the full rule is in hooks/mods/README.md, "sheet"), the session's sminos address (a Sminos-Session line, which sminos who reads back) at the end of every commit message and PR body it writes, and its name: a name sminos derive proposed after what the session is in charge of, applied with the engine's own /rename once the session is between turns and sminos name-due finds it still due. smns-record.sh (SessionStart, Stop): a session in a project joins its sminos log at its start, and its <message> marks and async asks reach the log as messages to the host (the bridge's export, where it runs, has put them there already); a session with a question sheet writes at Stop what the sheet owes the log. smns-derive.sh (SessionStart, compact): each compaction starts sminos derive of the session in the background, so its in-charge line and summary (and its name, where sminos names it) follow the work rather than waiting out the six-hour spacing. smns-guide.sh (SessionStart, every source): on a machine enrolled at a desk hub, the session reads who it is in the org (alias, project and why, machine) and the sminos verbs that find and reach the org's other sessions, and after a compaction or a resume the members it exchanged sminos messages with, as the logs hold them now. smns-tasks.sh (SessionStart, every source): where this machine's Task Board store exists, the session reads how many tasks it assigned to the human are open and which of the human's acts on them it has not been shown, each act named once and marked shown only after the line was printed. smns-cleared.sh (SessionEnd): at a /clear, the payload naming the session left is kept for the new session's hooks, which move its alias to the new session, and the identity of the question sheet it left, for the daemon's sweep
